---
title: "Where Does My Time Go?"
subtitle: "A Personal Visualization Journey Through My Google Calendar"
author: "Kristen Wang"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

calendar <- read_csv("pvj_calendar_anonymized_v1_updated.csv")
```

```{r}
weekday_order <- c(
  "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu",
  "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"
)

weekly_summary <- calendar |>
  filter(category != "Deadline / Reminder") |>
  mutate(
    weekday = factor(weekday, levels = weekday_order)
  ) |>
  group_by(weekday, category) |>
  summarize(
    avg_hours = sum(duration_hours) / 8,
    .groups = "drop"
  )



```

```{r}
ggplot(
  weekly_summary,
  aes(
    x = weekday,
    y = avg_hours,
    fill = category
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Where Does My Time Go?",
    subtitle = "Average scheduled hours by weekday, Fall 2026",
    x = "Day of Week",
    y = "Average Scheduled Hours",
    fill = "Activity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
